QuestInfo.1:
<Invisible Ghost>
There's a rumor of a specter trapped in a mansion on some remote island. The specter created an astral projection of itself, known as the Invisible Ghost, and it sent this Invisible Ghost to travel the world and haunt as many people as it could find. Although you can't see it (because it's invisible, obviously!), but you can sense it when it's near you...
It's said that the Invisible Ghost is attracted to the noise of a monster hunt. Maybe it will come to you while you are hunting.

<Spirit of Haven>

A ghost that used to be sighted only in Haven is now being sighted all over the world. Swallow your fear and snap a photo when it appears. Maybe it will reveal itself while you're hunting monsters...
